title: School Management System Interactive Demo
imageAlt: Administrator home dashboard of the School Management System demo, showing student, teacher, parent and class totals for a fictional school
description: A backend-free, public demo of the multi-tenant school platform I lead, built so schools can try it without seeing anyone's real data.
features: Built in 7 days with Claude Code: 4 roles across 5 one-click personas and 30+ pages.
Fictional data that is wiped on sign-out; nothing is sent to a server.
34 Playwright specs, including automated accessibility checks.

title: GENR8 Pipeline Interactive Demo
imageAlt: Admin dashboard of the GENR8 Pipeline demo for a fictional manufacturer, showing 81% pipeline completion across 148 work orders
description: An operations demo (work orders, materials, maintenance and safety) driven by a deterministic data engine instead of a backend.
features: Generates a consistent year of operations for 7 fictional businesses and 3 roles.
Invariant tests check the generated data for every day of a leap year.
Shipped in 10 days (33 PRs) with Claude Code, custom ESLint rules and build guards.

title: Geo-Info REST API
description: A RESTful API in Go that returns geospatial and demographic data about a country by name.
features: Ristretto in-memory caching and per-client rate limiting.
Interactive Swagger documentation; deployed as a Docker container.
